## 平台与产物 (Platforms & Assets)

**Single universal jar** — install on every supported platform.
The mod auto-detects the host OS at startup:

- **Linux x86_64 / arm64** — full capture + share + view (Portal ScreenCast / PipeWire / xwayland-satellite)
- **Android x86_64 / arm64** — full capture + share + view (OnyxLauncher, etc.)
- **Windows / macOS / iOS** — viewer-only (receives shared windows, no local capture; native platform auto-detect skips libwaylandcraft.so)
- **Dedicated server** — pure Java server-side logic (give / permission / share)

- waylandcraft-1.2.35.jar
